reason: I need a bike at the station every morning at the same time, and with 10 bikes spread over the whole town I can't plan my commute around maybe finding one. I'd rather keep taking the bus or walk than risk being late for training.
objection: With only 10 bikes there won't be one at the station when my train gets in, and I can't build my day around luck.
would_change_my_mind: A few bikes always parked at the train station, ideally one I can reserve in the app before I get off the train, and the 5 euro rate for apprentices too.
